llm_reason: R2 diagnosis: V2 (N/P up) rejected - worse plating (-0.248 V, deeper cathode at the 4.2 V cutoff dominates anode surface potential) AND SEI@100 518.4 nm > 500 nm fails the 100-cycle contract; V1 and V3 both improve plating and pass SEI@100, so R3 combines them (V4) and extends the stronger lever (V6). C1 is the ceiling-assessment escalation to Stage 2 (material bottleneck: no architecture lever scales per-area ec-limited SEI thickness; SEI kinetic rate constant is the bridge key for ec-reaction-limited growth). C1 is an inorganic-coating candidate (Al2O3/TiO2-coated graphite class) - per protocol inorganic ionic solids skip the molecular funnel (ML potentials/xTB unreliable for ionic solids) and go directly to Stage 3 aging validation; bridge value k_SEI 1e-12 -> 4e-13 (x0.4) marked ESTIMATE based on literature SEI-suppression magnitude of ALD Al2O3-coated graphite (domain experience: Jung et al., Adv. Mater. 2010, 22, 2172 - ultrathin ALD coatings on composite electrodes). Cooling h deliberately left at default 10 (lowering it would warm the cell and flatter the 4C plating test - perverse for a grid-storage design; recorded for honesty).
